measured_location: Nucleo PA6/BKIN, not independent measurement at IPM SD pin14
interpretation: The captured sub-microsecond PA6 pattern is unlike the documented typical internal fault-hold waveform. This prioritizes SD-path interference/continuity and capture integrity; it does not prove either or categorically exclude an IPM fault.
next_discriminating_evidence: Independent timing of SD at IPM and at Nucleo, together with qualified VCC/CIN/current evidence if module SD asserts; existing PA6-only DMA cannot distinguish all cases.
